title: Long Dormancy and the Reactivated Service Level of a Ship-To
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — dormancy at reactivation.**

Dormancy drops follow the whole months between the ship-to's last order date and the reactivation date: two drops where they are at least 30, one drop where they are at least 18 and fewer than 30, and none where they are fewer than 18 or the ship-to has no last order date. Each level drop moves the reactivated level one place down the service level ranking.

Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than the day of the month of the earlier date.

| Whole months from the last order date to the reactivation date | Dormancy drops |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 2 |
| 18 to 29 | 1 |
| fewer than 18 | none |
| no last order date on the ship-to | none |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical)**

- Last order on the 5th of a month; reactivation on the 5th of the month 30 calendar months later: 30 whole months, two drops. Reactivation on the 4th of that month: 29 whole months, one drop.
- 18 whole months: one drop; 17 whole months: none.
